answer_1.quote: The project aimed to leverage advances in self-supervised speech representation learning for unsupervised unit discovery and generative neural language models to jointly learn the acoustic and linguistic characteristics of a language from audio alone, without access to textual supervision...
answer_1.outputs: The paper focuses on training Speech-based Language Models (SLMs) to generate sequences of speech tokens and evaluate their linguistic performance through zero-shot tasks on syntax and semantics, within the Generative Spoken Language Modeling (GSLM) framework.

answer_2.quote: For downstream evaluation we rely on the zero-shot metrics used in the textless NLP literature, which evaluate LMs' linguistic knowledge by comparing likelihoods of positive and negative speech samples.
